shared_elements: upright freestanding carved stone monolith / slab
low-relief carving covering the face of the stone
rounded cartouche-like elements arranged in vertical succession
a broadly rectangular, taller-than-wide format with a plain base/plinth
traces of a face-like or anthropomorphic motif in the relief
justification: Both show a tall, upright carved stone with relief motifs organised vertically down a broad frontal face and set on a plain base, and both include roundel/disc elements amid the carving. But A is a dense, ruled two-column grid of small square glyph blocks rendered as a fine-lined engraving, while B is a single weathered anthropomorphic mass with a few large, shallow, softly modelled motifs photographed in a gallery — the ordering logic and the manner of rendering are quite different.
